name: Temper
description: The person's temper in view from Orca: active goals, tasks in progress and the latest handoff, read through the temper API on a credential borrowed from the temper CLI.

settings.title: Temper goals contexts
settings.description: Comma-separated context refs the Active goals group reads, such as @me/temper, +team/contrib. Leave unset to read the Temper context setting.

settings.title: Temper work contexts
settings.description: Comma-separated context refs the Tasks in progress and Latest handoff groups read, such as +team/contrib-workflows. Leave unset to read the Temper context setting.

settings.title: Temper context
settings.description: The context ref both groups read when the goals-contexts and work-contexts settings are left unset, such as @me/temper.

settings.title: Temper API origin
settings.description: Override for the temper API origin. Leave unset to use the origin temper auth status reports (the API the temper CLI presents the borrowed token to), so the token and the API always come from the same deployment.
